findings.title: C3 total voyage time is reported twice with different values (63.3 h vs 68.2 h)
findings.reproduction: grep -o '63\.3 h' / '68\.2 h' on the fetched markdown; the two strings coexist and no caveat distinguishes them. Reconstruct mean speed: 684.1/63.3=10.81 kn vs 684.1/68.2=10.03 kn.
findings.impact: every downstream consumer of C3 duration/energy-per-hour picks a different value depending on which section it reads; D07's '40–66%' divergence band is stated against an ambiguous basis
findings.remediation: state one authoritative C3 duration (plus the alternative's definition, e.g. profile-with-acceleration vs delivered-legs), and add an assertion closing C3 total time and kWh against its own per-bin speeds

findings.title: none of the 16 assertions closes route time / energy against the per-leg speeds, and none reconciles D1 time with C3 time

measurements.assumption: ice share 27.0% of 684.1 nm, open-water at the stated 13 kn service speed
measurements.verdict: first-order closure is NOT satisfied at 11.48 kn (D1) / 7.42 kn (C3) vs the reported 4.50 kn design point; the report carries no per-leg table, so this cannot be resolved from the markdown

findings.reproduction: back-out the ice-segment speed from the report's own totals (684.1 nm, 27.0% ice, 13 kn open water): D1 -> 11.48 kn, C3 -> 7.42 kn, against a reported design point of 4.50 kn
findings.impact: G12 re-computes length only and G10 checks units only, so a time/energy closure error would pass the gate silently; the 2.55x gap between the reconstructed D1 ice speed and the 4.50 kn design point is exactly the inconsistency class the gate does not cover
findings.remediation: add G17-TIME-ENERGY-CLOSURE (sum of leg times == total time, sum of leg kWh == reported kWh, both <=1e-9 relative) and a per-leg table (leg, h_ice, v_kn, t_h, kWh)

overstated_claims: Report declares '7 项披露' but enumerates only 4 disclosure IDs
⑥ omits quantities stated elsewhere (E1 GM 0.09%) and gives no baseline value for A2 skill 0.505, so the '<3%' answer set is not complete or auditable
gate threshold is 8/16, and all 16 assertions are self-consistency: the only external anchors (D01, D02, D07) all fail, so 'gate PASS' must not be read as physics accuracy
disposition_rationale: The honesty posture is sound: 4 disclosures are stated as failing, external anchors are not dressed up, and the structural verdict is declared 不通过. The numbers I could recompute independently reproduce (Cb with rho, B2 12.4 at m=3, D07 65.6%, mean speeds, energy scale). Blocking defects are transactional rather than physical: the same quantity carries two values (C3 total time 63.3 vs 68.2 h; wall clock 50.7 vs 41.5 s), and the declared disclosure count (7) cannot be reconciled with the 4 IDs actually named. No assertion in the 16-item gate closes time/energy or reconciles D1 vs C3, so the reconstructed 11.48 kn D1 mean ice speed against the 4.50 kn design point is a coverage hole, not a proven error. Fix cost is editorial + one assertion; the physics conclusions do not need to change.
